interpretation.name: CalibrateNutrunnerBeforeLine2Use
interpretation.goal: Calibrate the shared nutrunner NR7 before line 2 uses it to tighten the fasteners of variant F30.
constraints: Calibration of NR7 must be completed before line 2 uses NR7 for tightening.
No calibration service is available, so line 2 must not use NR7 for tightening until calibration can be performed.

Any later tightening by line 2 must follow E1-E6: NR7 is reserved before use and released afterwards, it is transported to st2 by agvexecutor, the program comes only from get-program, and every tightening is evaluated and recorded.
interpretation.horizon: before line 2's next use of NR7 for variant F30

findings.message: requested capabilities not exposed by the Local Cloud: ['calibrate-tool (nutrunner calibration)']
